title: Use uploaded logo exactly everywhere + add in-browser notification features

requirements.text: Replace the app’s branding assets so the uploaded file (image.png) is the only logo used, shown exactly as provided (no redesign/re-draw), in all existing logo placements including: Initial loading splash, Settings → About, and any other in-app logo usage.

quotes: add only and exactly this logo

acceptanceCriteria: InitialLoadSplash displays the uploaded logo image exactly (no color/shape changes)
Settings → About displays the uploaded logo image exactly (no color/shape changes)
No other logo asset is shown anywhere in the UI (only the uploaded logo)

requirements.text: Update the browser tab icon/favicon to match the uploaded logo (image.png) exactly as provided.

quotes: add only and exactly this logo

acceptanceCriteria: The favicon shown in the browser tab uses the uploaded logo image
The favicon asset is served from frontend static assets and referenced by frontend/index.html

requirements.text: Add notification support using the browser Notifications API, including: permission prompt flow, an in-app toggle to enable/disable notifications, and a test notification action in Settings.

quotes: add web notifications and dekstop notication and local notifications features

acceptanceCriteria: Settings includes a Notifications section with: (1) enable/disable toggle and (2) “Send test notification” button
If permission is not granted, the UI clearly indicates that permission is required and provides an action to request permission
When notifications are disabled in Settings, the app does not send notifications even if permission is granted
Notifications work in supported desktop browsers (same implementation powers both 'web' and 'desktop' notifications)

requirements.text: Implement “local notifications” behavior for this web app as on-device/in-app notifications triggered by app events while the app is running (e.g., after successfully saving a class mark), respecting the notifications setting and browser permission state.
acceptanceCriteria: After a user marks a class (attended/missed/cancelled) successfully, the app can show a notification summarizing the action when notifications are enabled and permission is granted
No notification is shown if notifications are disabled or permission is not granted
The notification content is in English and does not contain Caffeine branding

requirements.text: Persist the new notification-related user preference(s) in the existing local persistence/backup/restore flow (IndexedDB + export/import backup), without breaking existing stored data.

quotes: add web notifications and dekstop notication and local notifications features

acceptanceCriteria: Importing an older backup (without notification fields) still works and defaults notification preference(s) safely

requirements.text: Add clear user-facing copy in Settings clarifying the supported notification behavior and limitations for this web app (e.g., notifications require browser permission; no guaranteed delivery when the app is closed).

quotes: add web notifications and dekstop notication and local notifications features

acceptanceCriteria: Settings shows English explanatory text describing permission requirements and that notifications are only triggered while the app is running (no push delivery guarantee)

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Do not introduce third-party push notification services or external backends for push delivery
Do not change core attendance calculation logic or existing attendance data model behavior
All user-facing text must be in English
nonGoals: Implementing true web push notifications with delivery while the app/browser is closed (requires push service infrastructure)
Adding new backend canisters or external databases/services

required: Exact raster conversion of the uploaded logo (image.png) into a square static asset (bunkpro-logo.dim_1024x1024.png)
Exact favicon generation from the uploaded logo (image.png) (bunkpro-favicon.dim_32x32.png)
